metadata.canon_status: non_canonical. Biology lives in data/knowledge/species/**; this file only adds the sizing numbers the configurator needs and points back to canon.
metadata.range_convention: Every number is {low, high}. 'low' and 'high' are the ends of the sourced range, not pessimistic and optimistic cases; the configurator decides which end is favourable.
metadata.reliability_fields: AGENTS.md 6A: source_tier (tier_1 to tier_3), source_gate, confidence, confidence_reason, corroboration {status, source_ids}.

srac_454_rakocy_masser_losordo.citation: Rakocy, Masser, Losordo, SRAC Publication 454, Recirculating Aquaculture Tank Production Systems: Aquaponics - Integrating Fish and Plant Culture (revised 2016)

uvi_aquaponic_system_design.citation: Rakocy, Bailey, Shultz, Danaher, Design and Operation of the UVI Aquaponic System / A Commercial-Scale Aquaponic System (UVI)
uvi_aquaponic_system_design.note: University research-station design summary of the 214 m2 commercial-scale system.

rakocy_2004_uvi_tilapia_basil_acta_hort_.citation: Rakocy, Shultz, Bailey, Thoman 2004, Acta Horticulturae 648:63-69 (canon: data/knowledge/species/plants/basil.json, approved by Ajit 2026-11-25)

research_pack_tilapia_feed.citation: data/sources/research_reports/markdown/Tilapia feed-regime and stocking-input research pack for a first fish-feed-to-water-quality MVP.md (FCR 1.5-1.8 for intensive grow-out; cites SRAC and WorldFish)
research_pack_tilapia_feed.note: Repo research pack summarising Tier 1 sources; not read at the primary source in this pass.

nfdb_ras_recent_trends.citation: National Fisheries Development Board (Govt of India), Recent Trends in Aquaculture: Recirculatory Aquaculture System (RAS), GIFT tilapia RAS model and PMMSY unit costs
nfdb_ras_recent_trends.note: Official scheme model, undated (file name suggests 2017). Internal arithmetic inconsistencies found: 6,000 vs 4,500 fingerlings per tank, feed total vs feed cost.

basil_canon_crop_cycle.citation: data/knowledge/species/plants/basil.json validation_benchmarks.aquaponics_context.crop_cycle_context (8 plants/m2, 28-day growing period, deficiency visible by harvest 4)

fcr.source_gate_reason: Research pack summary of SRAC/WorldFish ranges; intensive tank grow-out, not aquaponics-specific.
fcr.confidence_reason: Several Tier 1 sources agree on 1.4-1.8 for tank grow-out; aquaponic studies report 1.46-1.88.
fcr.note: NFDB's RAS model uses 1.3, lower than this band; kept as a cross-check, not used.

annual_production_kg_per_m3_tank.unit: kg fish harvested / m3 rearing tank / year
annual_production_kg_per_m3_tank.confidence_reason: Direct UVI figure (5 t/yr from 4 x 7.8 m3 tanks), staggered culture with aeration; one site, tropical water temperature.
annual_production_kg_per_m3_tank.cross_check: 5,000 kg / 31.2 m3 = 160 kg/m3/yr, consistent with the stated figure. Per-crop densities in the tank research pack (61.5-70.7 kg/m3) are per harvest, about 2.3 harvests a year.

harvest_weight_kg.source_gate_reason: Official scheme model, but a planning figure, not a measurement.
harvest_weight_kg.confidence_reason: Single planning figure; the UVI documents read do not state individual harvest weight.

yield_kg_per_m2_yr.unit: kg harvested fresh cut mass / m2 grow area / year
yield_kg_per_m2_yr.source_gate_reason: Peer-reviewed, values already accepted in canon by Ajit.
yield_kg_per_m2_yr.confidence_reason: Staggered 23.4 and batch 25.0 kg/m2/yr from one tropical site; Dutch light and heat not represented.
yield_kg_per_m2_yr.cross_check: UVI design summary: basil 5 t/yr on 214 m2 = 23.4 kg/m2/yr.
yield_kg_per_m2_yr.note: Harvested cut mass, not saleable_harvest_mass_kg. NFT and media-bed yields are not sourced; the configurator reports them as missing.

feeding_rate_ratio_g_per_m2_day.unit: g fish feed / m2 plant area / day
feeding_rate_ratio_g_per_m2_day.source_gate_reason: Design ratio stated by the system's lead researchers.
feeding_rate_ratio_g_per_m2_day.confidence_reason: Design range for raft culture; not specific to basil or lettuce.

planting_density_plants_per_m2.confidence_reason: UVI trial density; authors note higher density could work.

harvests_per_planting.source_gate_reason: Derived: canon says deficiency becomes visible by harvest 4 and survival falls with successive cutting; replanting after 4 cuts is an inference.
harvests_per_planting.confidence_reason: Agent inference from canon; drives seed count only, which is a small cost line.

yield_kg_per_m2_yr.unit: kg fresh heads / m2 grow area / year
yield_kg_per_m2_yr.source_gate_reason: Derived: UVI 1,404 cases/yr x 24-30 heads per case on 214 m2 = 157-197 heads/m2/yr, times canon head weight anchor 150 g. Mixes two sources.
yield_kg_per_m2_yr.confidence_reason: Case mass is not given by UVI, so head weight is borrowed from the canon anchor; single tropical site.

heads_per_m2_yr.confidence_reason: Direct annual output figure from the UVI system.

feeding_rate_ratio_g_per_m2_day.unit: g fish feed / m2 plant area / day
feeding_rate_ratio_g_per_m2_day.source_gate_reason: Design ratio stated by the system's lead researchers.
feeding_rate_ratio_g_per_m2_day.confidence_reason: Design range for raft culture; not specific to lettuce.
